request: Can we make GlobBuilder reject an unclosed class even when literal_unclosed_class is enabled, so malformed patterns always fail validation?

source.request: Can we make GlobBuilder reject an unclosed class even when literal_unclosed_class is enabled, so malformed patterns always fail validation?
source.settled: Enabling literal_unclosed_class makes GlobBuilder treat unclosed character classes as literal text instead of returning an error.
source.why: Rejecting those patterns even with the option enabled removes the literal treatment the ticket added.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file.
